sources.snippet: Meta Platforms, Inc. is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Menlo Park, California. Meta owns and operates several prominent social media platforms and communication services
Before it was rebranded as Meta in October 2021, Meta was known as Facebook Inc . According to Zuckerberg, the name Meta emphasizes their focus on VR
